description: Shared preset: pinned digests, a 7-day cooldown, automerge of safe updates after green checks

customManagers.description: The shared pipeline in GitLab CI: a remote include pinned to the commit of a release

packageRules.description: Patch, pin and digest updates merge once all checks pass
Minor updates of stable (1.0+) dependencies merge once all checks pass
Renovate cannot find the release age of these updates and would hold them forever. Set the cooldown of lock files in the package manager
Only Docker Hub gives image release dates. Renovate proposes images from other registries at once, and a person merges them
One PR for all GitHub Actions updates. A pipeline release gets its own PR, because it can bring new findings
A project that follows the shared pipeline on main does so on purpose; pinned releases still update
